events.name: IMPERIAL PATROL
events.description: Patrol approaching outpost. All players should seek cover.

events.name: POWER FAILURE
events.description: Outpost power grid unstable. Terminals may go offline.

events.name: REBEL FLEET ARRIVAL
events.description: Alliance reinforcements are inbound. All rebels report in.

events.name: BOUNTY POSTED
events.description: New high-value target identified. Check the wanted board.

events.name: SECTOR LOCKDOWN
events.description: Imperial security lockdown initiated. All terminals offline.

events.name: EVENT ALPHA
events.description: Mid-event story beat — actors should escalate intensity.

events.name: FINALE INITIATED
events.description: Final phase begins. All players converge on the hub.

comms.subject: OPERATION BRIEF
comms.body: All operatives, welcome to the outpost. Mission parameters have been transmitted to your datapads. Proceed with caution.

comms.subject: PATROL WARNING
comms.body: Imperial patrol detected. Avoid the eastern corridor for the next 10 minutes.

comms.subject: RECALL ORDER
comms.body: All operatives, return to the hub. New orders are being distributed.

comms.subject: FIELD COMMENDATION
comms.body: Outstanding work. Your service has been logged. Continue current operations.

comms.subject: INTEL DROP
comms.body: Check the eastern panels — there is something there that you have missed.

comms.subject: EXTRACTION INBOUND
comms.body: Lambda shuttle approaching the hub. All operatives standby for evacuation.

bounties.description: Smuggler operating near cargo bay. Armed. Approach with caution.
clues: Last seen near the cargo bay scanning crates.
Wears a faded brown jacket. Carries a comlink.
Limp in the left leg — old blaster wound.

bounties.description: Imperial defector wanted by ISB. High threat level.
clues: Travels with a stormtrooper helmet under his arm.
Heard asking about freighter departures off-world.
ISB tracker says he is heading to the trade post.
Twi'lek female, dark green lekku, civilian clothes.
Carrying a small datachit on a leather cord.
Last seen entering the eastern corridor.

bounties.description: Black market dealer. Last seen at the trade post.
clues: Always escorted by two Gamorrean guards.
Trades only in unmarked credit chips.
Hangs out behind the trade post after dark.
